text: This session's link is https://claude.ai/code/session_01CvQ2JEQtk2btPfKzkuVyD9 . Paste it into your phone's browser (or tap it) while signed in to the same Claude account as the routine. It's a scheduled-routine session, which is probably why the Code list looks blank. I can't promise it will show an approval prompt there: I only know the check asked for approval in the session itself. If the link doesn't give you a prompt, don't spend more time on it: the manual route works, so place one Kalshi bet by hand in Kalshi's own app, which moves your cash to the right shard automatically. Also v1.0.57 is out (link above): try one bet in Vigilant and send me the red text, it will list your cash per shard, and we'll know for sure.
